0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1, third in the Northwest and 6th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (1-3, fourth in the Pacific and 12th in the West) in their fifth game of the season, after Minnesota lost its most recent game following three wins in its last four. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Anthony Edwards is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), while Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 127-117 victory in San Francisco on March 13.
